In this video, we will understand the purpose of cache and persist in PySpark — what they do, how they improve performance, and how to visualize their impact through Spark UI. We’ll also explore different storage levels and when to use each.

What you’ll learn:
Difference between cache and persist in PySpark
How caching improves performance using lazy evaluation

When Spark recomputes transformations and how cache prevents it
